summary: Website downloads always lead to an installer, and search results go to the Stratos homepage.
releaseNotes: Searching for Stratos now leads to the homepage instead of inner app pages or an old preview address.
The website's macOS download links work again: when a release has no build for a platform, the newest one that does is offered.
